description: This Java class 'BuildLogger' extends Gradle's BuildAdapter to log build events, including start time, finish time, build actions, results, and task statuses to a specified output file.

classes.name: BuildLogger
classes.description: A custom Gradle build listener that logs build start, finish, and task statuses to a specified output file.

methods.name: BuildLogger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the output file and writes the build start timestamp.

methods.name: taskToString
methods.description: Converts a TaskState object to a string representation indicating its status.

methods.name: exceptionToString
methods.description: Converts a Throwable exception and its causes to a string message.

methods.name: projectsEvaluated
methods.description: Logs the start time and Gradle version when projects are evaluated.

methods.name: buildFinished
methods.description: Logs the build finish time, result, and task statuses when the build completes.

methods.name: appendToFile
methods.description: Appends a string output to the log file if it exists.
